bbps.description:
BBPS-specific details required when creating an order for a BBPS bill payment. Pass this block only for BBPS payments processed through Cashfree's Customer Operating Unit (COU).

You can provide bill details in one of two ways:

- **`bills` array**: the standard format that supports single and multiple bill payments. Both prefunding and postfunding (shortfall) Agent Institutions can use this format. Postfunding Agent Institutions must use this format.
- **Top-level fields** (`bill_fetch_ref_id`, `biller_id`, `agent_id`): supported only for prefunding Agent Institutions for a single bill payment. These fields are retained for backward compatibility. Do not pass these if you are using the `bills` array.

You cannot send both top-level fields and the `bills` array in the same request. Doing so returns a validation error.

**Pay Together:** To pay bills across multiple billers in a single order, pass multiple objects in the `bills` array. Each object represents one bill with its own `biller_id`, `agent_id`, and `amount_to_be_paid`. The `amount_to_be_paid` is the actual amount the customer is paying against that bill. This can be less than the bill amount for partial payments or more than the bill amount if the customer is paying overdue charges. For postfunding Agent Institutions, the sum of `amount_to_be_paid` across all bills, minus the sum of `shortfall_amount` across all bills, plus the sum of all `vendor_splits` amounts across all bills, must equal `order_amount`.

For more details on prefunding and postfunding Agent Institutions, see [BBPS for Customers](/api-reference/other-apis/bbps-cou/overview).

bill_fetch_ref_id.description: Reference ID returned from the BBPS Bill Fetch Response API. Required when using top-level fields. Supported only for prefunding Agent Institutions. Do not pass this field if you are using the `bills` array.

biller_id.description: Unique identifier of the biller on the BBPS network. Required when using top-level fields. Supported only for prefunding Agent Institutions. Do not pass this field if you are using the `bills` array.

agent_id.description: Unique ID assigned to the BBPS agent upon registration at NBBL. Required when using top-level fields. Supported only for prefunding Agent Institutions. Do not pass this field if you are using the `bills` array.

bills.description: Array of bill details for the payment. Each object represents one bill. Pass a single object for a standard bill payment or multiple objects for a Pay Together payment across multiple billers. Both prefunding and postfunding Agent Institutions can use this format. Postfunding Agent Institutions must use this format. Each bill must have a unique `biller_id`. Passing more than one bill for the same biller in a single request is not allowed and results in a validation error.

bill_fetch_ref_id.description: Reference ID returned from the BBPS Bill Fetch Response API. Required for FETCH_AND_PAY and VALIDATE_AND_PAY flows. Not required for direct payment flows where no bill fetch is performed.

biller_id.description: Unique identifier of the biller on the BBPS network.

agent_id.description: Unique ID assigned to the BBPS agent upon registration at NBBL. This is provided to you after your onboarding and agent creation at NBBL. Contact your Cashfree account manager if you have not received this.

amount_to_be_paid.description: The actual amount the customer is paying against this bill in INR. This can differ from the billed amount: it can be less for a partial payment or more if the customer is paying overdue charges. For postfunding Pay Together orders, the sum of `amount_to_be_paid` across all bills, minus the sum of `shortfall_amount` across all bills, plus the sum of all `vendor_splits` amounts across all bills must equal `order_amount`.

shortfall_amount.description: The portion of the bill amount not collected through the payment gateway, to be covered by the Agent Institution's shortfall wallet. For example, if a bill is for 1000 INR and the customer redeemed 200 coins on the Agent Institution's platform, only 800 INR is collected via the payment gateway. The remaining 200 INR is the shortfall amount. This value must match the `shortfall_amount` passed in the `payment_breakdown` field of the [Bill Payment Request API](/api-reference/other-apis/bbps-cou/bill-payment/request). Applicable only for postfunding (shortfall) Agent Institutions.

vendor_splits.description: Per-bill split settlement details. Use this when the Agent Institution wants a portion of the customer's payment to be settled to the vendor account instead of the full amount going to the biller settlement flow. The sum of `vendor_splits` amounts across all bills in the `bills` array must equal the total `order_splits` amount passed at the top level of the Create Order request. Applicable only for postfunding (shortfall) Agent Institutions with split settlement enabled. For BBPS orders, the `order_splits` field supports only `amount`. If you pass `percentage` in `order_splits`, the request fails with a validation error.
